title: The Garel map of the relative Frobenius of a smooth morphism in characteristic p vanishes except in top degree, where it is surjective
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Garel map of the relative Frobenius of a smooth morphism in characteristic $p$: it vanishes in all degrees except the top one, where it is surjective (statement lines 4367-4380). The proof first shows the Frobenius is finite syntomic by checking flatness on fibres and using the lci property, then reduces the computation to affine space by etale charts and base change compatibility, and finally computes the map on the universal $p$-power map of polynomial rings through a trace formula obtained in the complex case, concluding the vanishing and the surjectivity. The explicit trace computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
